Lina (CS): Morning — quick weekly health check for BrightGrid. Can we confirm cache hit rate + avg batch size for Mon–Fri? I'm seeing spend tick up.

Omar (AM): Noted. Renewal in ~5 weeks — want any material regressions surfaced before the exec call.

Priya (SRE): From infra dashboard: overall cache hit 62%, prefix-hit 78%, avg batch size 4.1, p95 latency 340ms, error rate 0.13% (mostly 429 backpressure during peak).

Marc (Eng): We're observing smaller batches on short prompt flows. I pushed a batching-window tweak for theta-route to try to aggregate more requests. Patch:```json
{"route":"theta","old_window_ms":25,"new_window_ms":40,"sample_counts":{"before":2.3,"after":3.8}}
```

Priya (SRE): Pilot telemetry after the tweak: avg batch size from 3.9 -> 4.5 in the last hour on sample traffic. Cache hit moved 60% -> 66% for those routes.

Lina (CS): Nice. Any quick cost calc on cost per 1k tokens before/after?

Priya (SRE): Quick back-of-envelope: 
- before: $1.12 per 1k tokens (hit 62%, avg batch 4.1, baseline kernels)
- after: $0.96 per 1k tokens (batch + cache bump, same token mix)
- projected monthly savings @ current volume: ~$2.3k

Omar (AM): Good. I'll flag this as a positive in the renewal notes — customers like measurable unit-econ wins.

Marc (Eng): No errors introduced by the change, but small tail-latency increase for very short responses (~+30ms for <32 tokens). Not user-facing likely, but worth noting.

Lina (CS): Action items: 1) monitor this week for any error upticks, 2) Priya to attach sample traces for BrightGrid, 3) Marc will revert if errors increase. I'll schedule a 30m enablement with their PM to show cache/batch dashboards. @Priya (SRE) can you drop the trace link here?

Priya (SRE): Link: https://observability.redwood/trace/abc123 :mag: — attached sample trace and a short span-level note showing cache hits.

replay-bot: Auto-summed 7d metrics for BrightGrid: `hit_rate=65%`, `avg_batch=4.2`, `cost_per_1k=1.02` :ledger:

Lina (CS): Thanks all :heart: — I'll add this to the weekly account health note (renewal risk: low/monitoring) and capture customer feedback in the enablement.

Omar (AM): LGTM. If savings hold, we can surface a short case study on ops improvements for renewals. :thumbsup:
